config.instinct.title: Instinct
config.instinct.autoDetectAnimals.toolti: Classify unlisted animals as pets or livestock by heuristic. Off restricts coverage to tags and the include lists.
config.instinct.petsInclude.tooltip: Entity ids always treated as pets (e.g. minecraft:wolf), beyond tags and the heuristic.
config.instinct.petsExclude.tooltip: Entity ids never treated as pets. Exclude beats include and the heuristic.
config.instinct.livestockInclude.tooltip: Entity ids always treated as livestock, beyond tags and the heuristic.
config.instinct.livestockExclude.tooltip: Entity ids never treated as livestock. Exclude beats include and the heuristic.
config.instinct.mountsInclude.tooltip: Entity ids always treated as mounts (the horse family — self-preservation and downed only), beyond tags and the heuristic.
config.instinct.mountsExclude.tooltip: Entity ids never treated as mounts. Exclude beats include and the heuristic.
config.instinct.enableSelfPreservation.t: Pets and mounts path around hazards and flee mortal danger instead of walking into it.
config.instinct.creeperBerthBlocks.toolt: How far a pet keeps from a creeper about to explode. Range 2–8.
config.instinct.teleportSuppressFallDist: A pet won't teleport to an owner falling at least this many blocks, so it isn't yanked off a ledge. Range 0.5–10.
config.instinct.enableVeterancy.tooltip: Pets accrue days with age, gaining ranks and attribute bonuses.
config.instinct.veterancyThresholdDays.t: Accrued-day thresholds for ranks 1–3, ascending. Up to three entries, each 1–1000.
config.instinct.healthPerRank.tooltip: Bonus max health added per veterancy rank. Range 0–20.
config.instinct.damagePerRank.tooltip: Bonus attack damage added per veterancy rank. Range 0–10.
config.instinct.enableRankBehaviors.tool: Seasoned pets warn of threats, veterans duck your sweep, and elders mentor nearby pups.
config.instinct.warningRadiusBlocks.tool: How far a seasoned pet looks for threats to its owner. Range 8–24.
config.instinct.mentorRadiusBlocks.toolt: How close a pup must be to an elder pet to accrue days faster. Range 8–32.
config.instinct.mentorRateBonus.tooltip: Extra accrual fraction a mentored pup gains (0.25 = +25%). Range 0–1.
config.instinct.enableGenetics.tooltip: Bred livestock inherit bloodline grades and birth perks worth breeding for.
Graded animals with no product data still drop extra of their own vanilla drops.
config.instinct.hayRadiusBlocks.tooltip: How close a hay bale must be at breeding to raise the offspring's grade odds. Range 2–16.
config.instinct.crowdingThreshold.toolti: Nearby-animal count that counts as crowded and lowers offspring grade odds. Range 4–64.
config.instinct.crowdingRadiusBlocks.too: Radius the crowding count is measured over. Range 4–16.
config.instinct.gradeUpgradeChance.toolt: Base chance a well-bred offspring's grade improves. Range 0–1.
config.instinct.gradeDowngradeChance.too: Base chance a crowded offspring's grade drops. Range 0–1.
config.instinct.fertileRenewableReductio: How much the fertile perk shortens egg-laying and wool regrowth, per grade (0.15 = −15% each grade). Set 0 to keep fertile to breeding only. Range 0–0.5.
config.instinct.enableFlocking.tooltip: Herd animals hold formation and spacing as they move together.
config.instinct.flockSpeedMultiplier.too: How much faster tempted herd animals move than vanilla. Range 1–1.5.
config.instinct.flockSpacingBlocks.toolt: How far herd members keep from one another. Range 1–4.
config.instinct.enableHerding.tooltip: Whistling at livestock rounds up its group and drives it to you.
config.instinct.herdingMaxPets.tooltip: How many pets can drive a round-up at once. Range 1–4.
config.instinct.enableTrough.tooltip: The feeding trough passively feeds and breeds nearby livestock.
config.instinct.troughRadiusBlocks.toolt: How far the trough reaches to feed livestock. Range 4–24.
Ticks between trough feeding attempts. Range 10–200.
config.instinct.troughPopulationCap.tool: Above this many livestock in range, the trough stops breeding adults. Range 0–64.
config.instinct.enableWhistle.tooltip: The command whistle directs your pets to follow, stay, or attack.
config.instinct.whistleRadiusBlocks.tool: How far a whistle press reaches your pets. Range 8–48.
config.instinct.whistleTargetRangeBlocks: How far the attack whistle looks for a target. Range 8–64.
config.instinct.roundUpGroupRadiusBlocks: How far a round-up gathers the target's herd-mates. Range 4–16.
config.instinct.enableDownedState.toolti: A mortally wounded pet or mount drops downed and revivable instead of dying.
config.instinct.reviveHealthFraction.too: Fraction of max health a revived pet returns with. Range 0.1–1.
config.instinct.downedRankPenalty.toolti: A revived pet loses one veterancy rank's worth of days.
config.instinct.enableInspection.tooltip: Crouch-look at an animal to read its grade, perk, or veterancy on the action bar.
